verdict.rationale: The only risk-allocation statement in the evidence is the UCP design commitment that businesses "remain the Merchant of Record," which implies merchant-side liability. AP2 signed payment mandates, tied to cart state with "verifiable boundaries," are documented as fraud-mitigation mechanisms. Neither amounts to documented fraud, liability, or chargeback rules for agent-initiated transactions. missing for 10: explicit chargeback/dispute handling rules for agent orders, fraud-liability allocation between merchant, agent and Shopify, Shopify-specific (not just protocol-level) merchant risk documentation, independent corroboration

support.subject: As a merchant, the fraud, liability, and chargeback rules for agent-initiated transactions are documented so I know who bears the risk

citations.quote: remain the Merchant of Record, with full ownership of customer relationships
allows Platforms to provide cryptographically signed payment authorizations that are mathematically tied to the specific state of the cart
Allows autonomous AI agents to transact on behalf of users with pre-defined, verifiable boundaries.
